personality_one_liner: Energetic, tactile, and frictionless college delivery — blending vibrant yellow warmth with deep navy utility.

spacing.rule: Generous padding, clear visual modules instead of flat lists. Thumb zone prioritized.

navigation: bottom_tabs with role-based stack selection at root

screens.name: Auth / Role Select
screens.purpose: Phone OTP Sign In and role branching (Customer vs Employee).

states.loading: Spinner over full-screen tinted brand background.
states.error: Standard alert or inline red text below input.

screens.layout: Full screen stack. Large RYPPL logo/typography on top. Phone input field. Large primary CTA sticky at bottom keyboard view.

screens.name: Customer - Home
screens.purpose: Discover snacks and groceries to order.

states.empty: Illustration of empty shelves if no items available.

screens.layout: Search bar top (glass header). Hero featured carousel. Horizontal scrolling pill row for 10 categories (Drinks, Energy, etc.). 2-column product grid with 'space-between' and md gap. Floating bottom summary bar if cart has items.

screens.name: Customer - Product Detail
screens.purpose: View item details and add to cart.
screens.layout: Hero image half-screen with vertical gradient scrim at bottom. Title, price, rating in large typography. Segmented controls for sizes. Sticky yellow 'Add to Cart' button at bottom safe area.

screens.name: Customer - Cart & Checkout
screens.purpose: Review items, add tips, apply promos, and pay.

states.empty: Empty grocery bag illustration + 'Start Shopping' CTA.

screens.layout: List of cart item rows with inline quantity steppers (+/-). Promo code input cell. Tip selector implemented as a row of selectable pills ($1, $2, $5, Custom). Sticky 'Checkout' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Customer - Order Tracking
screens.layout: Vertical timeline UI with state machine badges (incoming, claimed, packing, etc.). Active state highlighted in brandPrimary. Map snippet showing campus delivery destination.

screens.name: Employee - Order Queue
screens.purpose: Packers and Runners claim incoming orders.

states.empty: Empty list illustration (e.g., chill mascot) - 'No orders yet.'

screens.layout: Top segmented control (Packer | Runner). Vertical list of robust order cards (Order ID, time elapsed, item count). Each card has a prominent 'Claim' button.

screens.name: Employee - Live Campus Map
screens.purpose: Runners view map of active deliveries.
screens.layout: Full-bleed map. Map pins colored by status: Green (unpacked), Red (packed), Blue (runner's own order). Tapping a pin summons a Gorhom bottom sheet with order details and 'Start Delivery' CTA.

screens.name: Employee - Active Delivery
screens.layout: Large delivery address text. Contact customer (SMS) button. Large swipe-to-complete or tap-and-hold 'Mark Complete' CTA to prevent accidental taps.

hero_featured.alt: Energy drinks and snacks featured background

delivery_runner.alt: Delivery runner with scooter on campus

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a Tactile/Playful (Personality 4) aesthetic: Use chunky cards, pill-shaped buttons, and slightly oversized tap targets.
The app serves two roles: Customer and Employee. Use role-based routing at the root to render distinct bottom tab navigators for each.
Colors: Use the defined Dark Blue (#0A2342) and Vibrant Yellow (#FFD600) heavily. Primary CTAs should be Yellow with Dark Blue text.

Map Status Pins (Employee Side): STRICTLY follow the brief's mapping -> success (Green) = unpacked, error (Red) = packed, info (Blue) = runner's own order. Since 'blue' was explicitly typed in the brief, it is permitted here.
Apply Glassmorphism to the bottom tab bar and sticky headers using expo-blur.
Customer Cart: Implement the tip selector as a horizontal row of pill-shaped chips, not a dropdown.
Every screen must have Loading, Empty, and Error states built-in using flex: 1 for full screen coverage.
Ensure the sticky bottom CTA on scrollable screens (like Checkout and Product Details) rests above a safe-area view and doesn't obscure the content list.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all screens with a filled/outlined distinction for active/inactive tabs.
For the Timeline order tracker, use a vertical line with colored nodes indicating the state machine steps (incoming, claimed_packer, packing, ready, claimed_runner, in_bag, on_road, complete).
No emojis allowed in any UI elements.
